name: Yuli Norbert
source:
Your butler.
The people call it an idol butler. I often say little devilish things, but I try to be on your side more than anyone else.
There seems to be something to do with Zeno, King of Stein ...?

[Taken from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/100puri/chara/100yuli_norbert.html]official website[/url]]
